text:
Alex Tuch left Buffalo messily (the headlines have the Sabres' GM pushing back on his account of it) and arrived in Washington scoring. Eleven goals in 16 games, eight in his last ten, and by our win probability his goals have added more wins than almost anyone's in the league: 13th of 515 skaters.

Two things pull in opposite directions. He's shooting 26%, against 17% last season, on 8.0 expected goals, so the goal pace will slow. But the Capitals have scored about 4.6 fewer goals than expected with him on, which is why he has only two assists. When that turns, the points should keep coming even as the goals cool.

Evolving-Hockey had him 53rd of 401 forwards in wins above replacement last season against top competition, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking calls him a setup man. None of his points have come on the power play. Our range says 31 to 47 goals.
